definitions.explanation: A prolonged duration of time, often used in contexts of planning, investment, or stays.

examples.japanese: {長期|ちょうき}⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
{長期|ちょうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{休暇|きゅうか}→休暇：02547_kyuuka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}りたい→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I want to take a long vacation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{長期|ちょうき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦べき→べき：10016_beki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This investment should be considered in the long term.

notes:
{長期|ちょうき} refers to an extended period, typically months to years. It functions as a noun and as a no-adjective modifier ({長期|ちょうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧).

COMPOUNDS:
- {長期|ちょうき}⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧ (long-term plan)
- {長期|ちょうき}⟦{滞在|たいざい}→滞在：03390_taizai⟧ (long stay, extended stay)
- {長期|ちょうき}⟦{休暇|きゅうか}→休暇：02547_kyuuka⟧ (long vacation)
- {長期|ちょうき}⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧ (long-term investment)
- {長期|ちょうき}⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧ (long-term interest rate)
- {長期|ちょうき}⟦{戦|せん}→戦：noentry⟧ (prolonged battle/struggle)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {長期|ちょうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる (extending over a long period)
- {長期|ちょうき}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (in the long run)
- {長期|ちょうき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (to think long-term)

TIME SCALE SERIES:
- ⟦{短期|たんき}→短期：04050_tanki⟧: short-term (days to weeks)
- ⟦{中期|ちゅうき}→中期：18820_chuuki⟧: medium-term
- {長期|ちょうき}: long-term (months to years)
